source: ZXNAME0000XZ avoids storing the full matrix in ZXNAME0001XZ. It forms score tiles, applies the softmax update while the tile is on chip, immediately uses those probabilities to accumulate the corresponding contribution from ZXMATH0000XZ then discards the tile.[4]
zh: ZXNAME0000XZ 避免将完整矩阵存储在 ZXNAME0001XZ 中。它形成分数图块，在图块位于芯片上时应用 softmax 更新，立即使用这些概率来累积来自 ZXMATH0000XZ 的相应贡献，然后丢弃该图块。 [4]
